# Gotham Noir

> Anti-halation nocturnal dark theme ecosystem (4 variants: Year One, Batcomputer, Arkham Slate, Vengeance) compiled from canonical OKLCH + APCA JSON palettes across 20+ editors, terminals, browsers, web apps, and shadcn/ui projects. Created by Zain Ahmed (https://zainahmed.net/).

## Agent Setup & Skills
- [Agent Skill (SKILL.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thezaynahmed/gotham-noir/main/skills/gotham-noir/SKILL.md): Installable Agent Skill (`npx skills add thezaynahmed/gotham-noir`) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, and Gemini CLI.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thezaynahmed/gotham-noir/main/AGENTS.md): Automated build, install, and verification steps.
- [Palette Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thezaynahmed/gotham-noir/main/skills/gotham-noir/references/palettes.md): Exact WCAG 2.1, APCA Lc, hex, and CSS variable tokens.

## Machine-Readable Tokens & Registries
- [W3C Design Tokens JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thezaynahmed/gotham-noir/main/ports/palette/tokens.json)
- [CSS Palette (gotham-noir.css)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thezaynahmed/gotham-noir/main/ports/palette/gotham-noir.css)
- [shadcn/ui Registry Item](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thezaynahmed/gotham-noir/main/ports/shadcn/r/gotham-noir.json)
